description: Several large colorful LEGO-style blocks are stacked together on the bed in front of the hands, with loose red, green, yellow, white, and blue pieces nearby. The left hand steadies the main stack while the right hand lifts off the green block to the right, then removes a red block and pulls the blue base piece away; after that, the right hand brings a red block over the remaining yellow-and-white section as the left hand holds it, and the structure is fully taken apart with the pieces set down separately on the bed.
